features: irsc[31:0] (Interrupt raw status and clear reg1)

testcases.Test Description: Verifies GPIO register default values and masked write/read behavior across listed registers using the bus interface. Confirms reads match documented reset values (with the least significant bit masked off) and that writable bits store and return expected values considering per-register read/write masks and default values.
testcases.Remarks: Default-value check masks off the least significant bit of each register read before comparison. Skip lists exclude specific registers from write/read or reset-value checks based on provided skip arrays.
Test Steps / Procedure: Entry: initialize test. Perform reset-value verification for each targeted GPIO register; skip any registers marked to be skipped for reset read checks; ignore non-readable addresses.

For each targeted register among GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 through GPIO_GP0_GPIO_39 and the listed group/status registers: perform a read and compare against its reset value after masking off the least significant bit; count a failure when a mismatch is observed.
Iterate through a fixed set of six data patterns; for each pattern, write masked data to every writable target register; skip non-writable and skipped registers.

After each write pass, read from every readable and writable target register; compute the expected value as the combination of the written pattern on writable-and-readable bits and the default value on read-only bits; compare with the read value; count a failure on mismatch.
Completion: if no default-value or write/read mismatches were counted, the test passes; otherwise the test fails.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Reset-value phase: for each address included in the reset check, the read value with its least significant bit cleared must equal the documented reset value; otherwise the default-value failure counter increments.

Write/read phase: for each address included, the read value must equal the expected value derived from the written pattern masked by the write and read masks plus preserved default bits on non-writable fields; otherwise the write/read failure counter increments.
Overall pass: both the default-value failure counter and the write/read failure counter remain zero at test completion.
steps: A. Entry point: test_case() calls reset-value check, then write/read check, then determines pass/fail.

B. Reset-value check runtime flow: for i in 0..CNT-1, fetch address from table; if reset-skip flag set, continue; if read mask is zero, continue; perform READ from the address; mask off bit0; compare to default-value table; on mismatch, increment default failure counter.
C. Write phase: define six fixed data patterns; for each pattern, iterate addresses; if write-skip flag set, continue; if write mask is zero, continue; perform WRITE with (pattern AND write mask).

D. Read/compare phase: iterate addresses; if write-skip flag set, continue; if write mask is zero, continue; if read mask is zero, continue; perform READ and AND with read mask; compute expected value using the current pattern, read mask, write mask, and the default value; compare and increment write/read failure counter on mismatch.
E. Completion: if both failure counters are zero then pass, else fail.
testcases.expected_results: All targeted registers return documented reset values (with bit0 cleared) and reflect written data on writable-and-readable bits while preserving default values on read-only bits.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass if both failure counters are zero; fail otherwise.
testcases.notes: The least significant bit of each read value is cleared prior to comparison during reset-value checks.
testcases.Hidden_Test_Description: Checks default values for listed GPIO registers and verifies masked write/read operations across all targeted addresses using arrays of addresses, masks, and defaults.
testcases.Hidden_Remarks: when reading default values the din value is becoming 1 automatically if we don't force any value,but if we force zero to din bit level sel becoming high,so that reding value not matched with expected value. Uses skip_array and skip_rst_array to omit specific addresses from write/read and reset checks.
Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure: int test_case(): calls chk_rst_val(); then chk_rd_wr(); finishes with status 1 if def_fail_cnt > 0 or wr_fail_cnt > 0 else 0.

void chk_rst_val(): for (i=0;i<CNT;i++): addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_rst_array[i]==1) continue; if (read_mask_array[i]==0) continue; data_rd=read_reg(addr); data=(data_rd & 0xfffffffe); if (data==default_value_array[i]) { PASS log } else { def_fail_cnt++; print failure }.

void chk_rd_wr(): chk_val[6]={0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0xf5f5f5f5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}; For each j in 0..5: data_wr=chk_val[j]; Write pass: for i=0..CNT-1: addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i]==1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i]==0) continue; write_reg(addr,(data_wr & write_mask_array[i])); Read/compare pass: for i=0..CNT-1: addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i]==1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i]==0) continue; if (read_mask_array[i]==0) continue; data_rd=(read_reg(addr) & read_mask_array[i]); wr_n=(write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if (data_rd==exp_val) { PASS log } else { wr_fail_cnt++; print failure }.

Registers accessed via addr_array include: MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8..MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_39, MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR2_INTR_EN1, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR2_INTR_STS1, MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1..4, MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_DOUT_GROUP1..4, MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_DIN_GROUP1..4. Operations: READ and WRITE as per loops.
Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: if(data == default_value_array[i]) for all i (with bit0 masked) and for every pattern/data_rd comparison equals exp_val, then finish(0); else finish(1).

testcases.Test Description: Configures input mode and falling-edge interrupt enable on GPIOs 8–39, enables the corresponding group interrupt and system interrupt routing, then generates one falling edge per pin and validates per-pin input state, raw status, group masked status, and proper clearing of both group and system interrupt status.
testcases.Remarks: Each pin is pre-cleared at the group raw status register before enabling the specific interrupt. A bounded wait with timeout is used to avoid indefinite hangs while waiting for the service routine to signal completion.
Test Steps / Procedure: Entry: initialize error counter; conditionally enable the appropriate interrupt line in the generic interrupt controller based on the selected instance.
Enable the system interrupt output for the selected GPIO instance in the system interrupt enable register.
Drive the pad output control to a known high state to establish a starting level.

For each pin index 0..31 corresponding to GPIO 8..39: configure the per-pin control register to input mode, enable falling-edge interrupt, and clear per-pin raw status; include a short wait between configurations.

For each pin index 0..31: clear the corresponding group raw bit, enable only that pin in the group enable register, insert a short wait, arm the completion flag, then generate a falling edge by briefly driving high followed by low on the external pad control; wait with a finite timeout for the service routine to acknowledge; on timeout, record an error.

In the interrupt service routine: acknowledge completion; restore the external pad drive to a high state; read the per-pin control/status and verify input is low after a falling edge; if the raw indicator is asserted, verify the corresponding bit in the group masked status register is set; clear the per-pin raw status and the group raw bit; verify the group masked status becomes zero; clear the system raw status for the selected instance; finally, clear the interrupt in the controller.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: During service, the per-pin input state must be low after the falling edge.
The per-pin raw indicator must be asserted for the serviced pin; the corresponding group masked status bit must be set prior to clearing.
After clearing per-pin raw status and group raw status, the group masked status must read as zero.
System raw status for the selected instance must be cleared.
The test passes if no timeouts occur and all checks succeed for every pin; otherwise it fails.
steps: A. Entry point: test_case() initializes counters and conditionally enables one interrupt line in the controller based on the instance selection.
B. System routing: write to the system interrupt enable register to enable the GPIO instance output.
C. Initialize pad drive: write to the external pad control to drive all lines high.

D. Per-pin configuration loop (32 iterations): for each pin register from GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 upward in word steps, WRITE to set input mode, enable falling-edge interrupt, and clear raw latch; include a brief wait.

E. Per-pin activation loop (32 iterations): for each index, WRITE one-hot bit to the group raw clear register, WRITE the same one-hot bit to the group enable register, wait briefly, arm the completion flag, generate a falling transition on that bit using the external pad control, then wait in a bounded loop with a timeout; on timeout, record an error.

F. Service routine actions: clear the completion flag; restore the external pad drive high; READ the current pin register; verify input is low; if raw is set then READ the group masked status and verify the one-hot bit is set; WRITE the per-pin control to clear raw while retaining input mode; WRITE the group raw clear register with the one-hot bit; READ the group masked status and verify zero; WRITE the system raw status clear for the instance; clear the controller interrupt.
testcases.expected_results: Each pin’s falling edge generates an interrupt; the per-pin input reads low; the group masked status reflects the pin during service and becomes zero after clearing; the system raw status clears; no timeouts occur.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass if all pins complete without timeout and all ISR checks and clears succeed; otherwise fail.
testcases.notes: A finite timeout is used while waiting for the interrupt service routine to run to prevent indefinite waits.
testcases.Hidden_Test_Description: Enables negedge interrupts for GPIOs 8..39, routes instance interrupt via sysreg, generates falling edges via 0xA0243ffc pad control, and validates DIN low, raw bit set, group status set/clear, and sysreg clear in ISR.
testcases.Hidden_Remarks: Uses bounded wait (timeout=5000 with wait_on(10) per iteration). Pre-clears raw status per bit and re-drives pad lines high after servicing.
Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure: int test_case(): test_err=0; #ifdef GPIO0 GIC_EnableIRQ(87); #endif; #ifdef GPIO1 GIC_EnableIRQ(88); #endif; #ifdef GPIO0 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR); #endif; #ifdef GPIO1 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO1_INTR); #endif; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff); for (i=0;i<32;i++){ addr1=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); write_reg(addr1,(1u<<20)|(1u<<18)|(1u<<16)); wait_on(10);} for (i=0;i<32;i++){ wr_val=1u<<i; write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, wr_val); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, wr_val); wait_on(10); int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff); wait_on(30); write_reg(0xA0243ffc, ~wr_val); unsigned int timeout=5000; while (int_pend && timeout--){ wait_on(10);} if (timeout==0){ printf("ERROR: Timeout waiting for GPIO%u negedge interrupt\n", (unsigned)(i+8)); test_err++; }} finish(test_err);

void Default_IRQHandler(): unsigned int local_wr=1u<<i; int_pend=0; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff); raddr=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); rdata=read_reg(raddr); if ((rdata & 0x1)!=0){ test_err++; } if ((rdata & 0x2)!=0x0){ rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if ((rdata_grp & local_wr)==0){ test_err++; } raddr2=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); write_reg(raddr2,(1u<<20)|(1u<<16)); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, local_wr); rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if (rdata_grp!=0x0){ test_err++; } #ifdef GPIO0 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR); GIC_ClearIRQ(87); #endif #ifdef GPIO1 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR); GIC_ClearIRQ(88); #endif } else { test_err++; }
Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: ISR: if((rdata & 0x1) != 0) then error; if ((rdata & 0x2) != 0) then group status bit must be set (rdata_grp & local_wr) != 0 else error; after clears, group status must be 0 else error; system raw status is written to clear for GPIO0/GPIO1.

testcases.Test Description: Enables rising-edge interrupt on GPIOs 8–39, sets input mode via group IO control, enables group interrupts, then produces a rising edge for each pin and validates group masked status assertion and successful clearing of both group masked status and system raw status in the service routine.
testcases.Remarks: The service routine masks group interrupts during handling, clears all per-pin raw latches, verifies the group masked status is cleared, and clears the corresponding system raw status. A bounded wait prevents indefinite stalls while waiting for service completion.
Test Steps / Procedure: Entry: conditionally enable the appropriate controller interrupt line for the selected instance.
Enable the system interrupt output for the selected instance in the system interrupt enable register.
Per-pin configuration loop: for each pin index 0..31, enable rising-edge interrupt in its per-pin control register.
Set input mode for GPIOs 8–39 using group IO control registers for all four groups.
Enable all bits in the group interrupt enable register.

For each pin index 0..31: drive external pad control low, wait briefly, arm the completion flag, then drive high to create a rising edge; wait in a bounded loop for the service routine to acknowledge; on timeout, record an error; optionally re-drive low and wait before the next iteration.

In the service routine: acknowledge completion; read the group masked status; temporarily disable the group interrupt enable register; confirm that some group masked status is asserted; clear per-pin raw latches across all pins; verify the group masked status is zero; clear the system raw status for the selected instance; re-enable the group interrupt enable register; clear the interrupt in the controller.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Group masked status must be asserted during service.
After clearing all per-pin raw latches, the group masked status must read as zero.
System raw status must be cleared for the selected instance.
No timeout occurs while waiting for interrupt handling for any pin.
The test passes if the error counter remains zero at completion.
steps: A. Entry point: test_case() enables one interrupt line in the controller based on instance selection.
B. System routing: write to the system interrupt enable register for the GPIO instance.
C. Per-pin configuration: for each pin register from GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 upward in word steps, WRITE to enable rising-edge interrupt.
D. Group IO mode: WRITE group IO control registers for all four groups to place GPIOs 8–39 in input mode.
E. Group enable: WRITE all ones to the group interrupt enable register.

F. Stimulus loop (32 iterations): drive the external pad control low, wait briefly, arm the completion flag, drive high to create a rising edge, then wait with a timeout for service completion; drive low again and wait briefly before next iteration.

G. Service routine: clear the completion flag; READ group masked status; WRITE zero to the group interrupt enable register to mask during service; if masked status nonzero then log success else record error; for each pin index 0..31 WRITE to per-pin control to clear raw; wait briefly; READ group masked status and verify zero; clear the system raw status for the selected instance; re-enable the group interrupt enable register; clear the controller interrupt.
testcases.expected_results: Each pin’s rising edge causes a group masked status event which clears after per-pin raw latches are cleared; the system raw status clears; no timeouts occur.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass if all checks succeed and no timeouts occur; fail otherwise.
testcases.notes: Group enable is temporarily masked during ISR to avoid re-entry while clearing per-pin raw latches.
testcases.Hidden_Test_Description: Enables posedge interrupts for GPIOs 8..39, sets input mode via group IO control, enables group interrupt, then toggles external pad via 0xA0243ffc to create rising edges; ISR checks group status, clears per-pin raw, verifies group clear, clears sysreg, and re-enables group.
testcases.Hidden_Remarks: Uses bounded wait (timeout=2000 with wait_on(10) per iteration). Masks group enables during ISR via write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0x00000000).
